name: audit_goal
description: Run an epistemic blindfold mystery audit on a goal package to evaluate compliance and certify or reopen it.

persona.description: Optional foundation persona ID (defaults to mystery-auditor)

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

skip_canary.description: If true, skip negative mutant canary testing

url.description: Optional target URL for web service probing

name: audit_goals
description: Audit goals against recent git commits, detecting implemented goals with commit SHAs, and optionally auto-syncing goals/README.md.

project.description: Optional project ID or workspace root directory

name: audit_hygiene
description: Audit multi-toolchain disk storage, caches, and repository build residue across Go, pnpm, aube, npm, Cargo, Python (uv/pip), Bun, Zig, and mise. Returns reclaimable bytes and cleanable items without deleting anything.

heavy.description: If true, include heavy network-dependent caches (e.g. modcache, node_modules)

project.description: Optional project directory or ID (default: active workspace)

scope.description: Cleanup scope: repo (repository residue), global (user caches/package stores), or all (default)

targets.description: Optional list of toolchain targets to inspect (e.g. ['go', 'pnpm', 'aube'])

name: certify_goal
description: Certify a goal from evidence, or run its verification contract automatically with auto_run.

agent.description: Auditor identity (must differ from producer/claim holder)

auto_run.description: Run the goal's verification contract before certifying

evidence.description: Evidence file path (JSON facts or markdown review with Verdict: PASS)

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: check_symbol_blast_radius
description: Run an in-memory edit-check or safe-delete contract analysis for a symbol (equivalent to sila edit-check / safe-delete).

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

symbol.description: Symbol name or canonical pkg::Sym identifier

name: claim_goal
description: Claim and lock a goal package for an agent to prevent other agents from taking the same task.

agent.description: Optional agent identifier (e.g. claude-code, devin, antigravity)

allow_paths.description: Optional canonical repo-relative paths authorized for mutation

force.description: If true, override an existing active claim

note.description: Optional initial status or execution note

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

session.description: Optional session identifier to bind (UUID format recommended)

name: claim_handoff
description: Atomically claim an open or pending session handoff via Compare-and-Set (CAS), ensuring parallel agents and subagent swarms do not duplicate work.

agent_name.description: Name or role of the claiming agent (defaults to caller identity).

handoff_id.description: The ID of the handoff to claim (e.g. hoff_123456).

session_id.description: Unique session ID for idempotent retry and claim tracking.

name: clean_caches
description: Clean multi-toolchain build caches, package stores, and repository residue across Go, pnpm, aube, npm, Cargo, Python (uv/pip), Bun, Zig, and mise. Safely reclaims disk space.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate cleanup without deleting any files

heavy.description: If true, include heavy network-dependent caches (e.g. modcache, node_modules)

project.description: Optional project directory or ID (default: active workspace)

scope.description: Cleanup scope: repo (repository residue), global (user caches/package stores), or all (default)

targets.description: Optional list of toolchain targets to clean (e.g. ['go', 'pnpm', 'aube'])

name: cloudflare_d1_query
description: Execute SQL query or schema inspection against a Cloudflare D1 database with parameter support and safety sentry.

database.description: Optional D1 database ID or database name (defaults to configured or detected database)

params.description: Optional positional SQL parameters to bind to placeholders

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory for local wrangler resolution

query.description: SQL query to execute against the D1 database (e.g. 'SELECT * FROM messages LIMIT 10')

name: cloudflare_edge_telemetry
description: Retrieve edge runtime telemetry, request volume, error counts, and CPU execution time percentiles (p50, p99).

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

script_name.description: Worker script name (defaults to name detected from wrangler.jsonc)

name: cloudflare_worker_status
description: Inspect Cloudflare Worker deployment status, active script version, routes, compatibility date, and declared bindings.

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory for local wrangler resolution

script_name.description: Worker script name (defaults to name detected from wrangler.jsonc or 'sila-edge-bridge')

name: compare_proposals
description: Evaluate 2 or more competing architectural proposals or feature specs in an empirical tournament against project non-goals, invariants, and historical preferences.

context_query.description: Optional background question or architectural decision topic

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

proposals.description: Array of proposal statements, architecture designs, or plan texts (minimum 2)

name: compile_rules
description: Compile the latest project handoff, architectural memos, distilled facts, file-referenced claims (labelled as claims, never as facts), and reference docs into agent rule files (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md, .windsurfrules).

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug (default: active workspace)

target.description: Target format: claude (default), cursor, windsurf, agents

name: consult_personas
description: List, recommend, or bind specialist personas for a goal (equivalent to sila persona / sila hire).

goal.description: Goal slug for recommend or bind_goal

group.description: Optional persona group slug or number

personas.description: Persona IDs to bind to the goal

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: create_decision
description: Create an addressed epistemic decision record (D<number>) with lettered trade-off options and explicit recommendation.

address.description: Optional explicit address (e.g. 'D1') for testing or reservation

options.description: List of lettered options (minimum 2). Array of strings (e.g. ['A: Option 1', 'B: Option 2']) or option objects

project.description: Target project ID (defaults to cwd project)

rationale.description: Rationale or justification for the recommendation

title.description: Title or core question of the decision

name: create_goal
description: Create and scaffold a new goal package under goals/<slug>/ with goal.md, facts.md, and plan.md conforming to repository standards.

commit.description: Optional commit SHA when recording a retrospective goal (status='implemented')

depends_on.description: Optional array of goal slugs that must be completed first

description.description: Optional summary of what this goal accomplishes

files_to_touch.description: Optional array of file or directory paths this goal will modify (used for concurrency collision prevention)

independent.description: Explicitly declare whether goal is disjoint/independent (default: true if no depends_on)

invariants.description: Optional array of architectural invariants and constraints for facts.md

overwrite.description: If true, overwrite existing goal files

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

shape.description: Task shape: 'ship' (code modification, default) or 'scout' (non-mutating investigation report). Scout tasks are exempt from file collision checks.

spec_review.description: Optional structured spec_review object conforming to sila/spec-review/v1

status.description: Optional goal status: 'pending' (default) or 'implemented' for retrospective goal recording

strict.description: If true, reject goal creation if any file collisions or topological conflicts are detected

tasks.description: Optional array of discrete execution tasks or phases for plan.md

work_package.description: Optional structured work_package object conforming to sila/work-package/v1

name: diagnose_system
description: Run end-to-end system diagnostic health audit on SQLite DB integrity, FTS5 virtual indexes, project path existence on disk, and storage permissions, with optional automatic repair.

repair.description: If true, automatically rebuilds FTS5 indexes and optimizes query planner

name: emit_lifecycle_event
description: Emit an active agent lifecycle transition event (session-start, user-prompt, pre-tool-use, post-tool-use, pre-compact, post-compaction, stop, session-end) into Sila's non-blocking spooler (<5ms latency) for durable provenance without interactive hot-loop stalling.

agent.description: Emitting agent or tool identifier (e.g. antigravity, claude-code, devin)

drain.description: If true, immediately drains the spool queue into the SQLite store (default: false)

event.description: Canonical lifecycle event kind (e.g. session-start, user-prompt, pre-tool-use, post-tool-use, pre-compact, post-compaction, stop, session-end)

payload.description: JSON payload containing event arguments, tool execution details, or error context

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug

name: get_activity_digest
description: Summarize recent activity and time-windowed progress across sessions (equivalent to sila standup / sila digest).

activity.description: Return the source-attributed recent session activity list instead of the digest report

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

tool.description: Optional harness filter for the activity list

name: get_db_stats
description: Get detailed SQLite database storage statistics, including file size, page count, freelist pages, and fragmentation percentage.

name: get_doc
description: Retrieve the full text and metadata of a specific attached document by ID.

name: get_latest_handoff
description: Retrieve the most recent active session handoff for a project.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug (default: active workspace)

name: get_memory
description: Read one typed sila/memory/v1 record by id, including its envelope, authority label, grounding state and supersession status.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

name: get_message_context
description: Expand the verbatim conversation around a specific message ID, staying within its recorded source session. Use after search or omni_search to unroll the turns surrounding a hit — the before/after context that explains WHY something was done. Returns a note instead of misleading neighbors when session provenance is unavailable.

occurrence.description: 1-based selection among multiple recorded source occurrences of a deduplicated message (default 1)

name: get_operational_guidebook
description: Call to load Sila's domain engineering standards and guardrails across 10 domains. Retrieve curated cross-project operational learnings, battle-tested engineering patterns, and failure postmortems categorized by domain (golang, typescript, cloudflare, d1, devops, ci/cd, security, testing, a11y).

domain.description: Optional domain filter: golang, typescript, cloudflare, d1, devops, ci/cd, security, testing, a11y

format.description: Output format: markdown (default), json, html, toon, or summary

project.description: Optional project ID or directory filter

query.description: Optional keyword search filter across titles, symptoms, causes, fixes, and rules (alias: search)

search.description: Optional keyword search filter across titles, symptoms, causes, fixes, and rules (alias: query)

name: get_package_doc
description: Fetch official package and registry documentation for Go (pkg.go.dev), Rust (crates.io/docs.rs), NPM (npmjs.org), or Python (pypi.org) and optionally auto-ingest into project memory.

auto_save.description: If true, saves package doc into project knowledge store

ecosystem.description: Registry ecosystem: auto (default), go, rust, npm, python

project.description: Project ID to attach doc to

name: get_project_facts
description: Retrieve all distilled claims/facts for a specific project with pagination support.

facts_only.description: Filter by promoted, LLM-distilled facts only

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default all)

project.description: Optional project ID or alias (default: active workspace)

refs_exist_only.description: Filter by claims whose referenced files exist on disk

name: get_status
description: Get knowledge store health statistics and summary counts.

name: get_subagent_charter
description: Create and sign a local subagent continuity charter carrying the parent session, goal, lane, allow paths, and handoff policy.

allow_paths.description: Repo-relative paths the child may write

goal.description: Goal slug bound to the parent claim

name: go_diagnostics
description: Run gopls compiler and vet diagnostics across target package or directory without modifying code.

path.description: Package pattern or directory path to check (default: './...')

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: go_package_api
description: Inspect exported Go package types, interfaces, methods, functions, and documentation signatures using gopls or native AST parsing.

include_unexported.description: If true, also include unexported declarations (default: false)

pkg.description: Go package directory or import path (e.g. './internal/store')

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: go_symbol_references
description: Find all usages, call sites, and declarations of a Go symbol using gopls or pure-Go AST navigation.

dir.description: Optional package or workspace directory to search (defaults to file's directory)

file.description: Path to Go source file containing or referencing the symbol

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

symbol.description: Symbol or identifier name to search for (e.g. 'ApprovalCoordinator')

name: graph_report
description: Audit the code + memory graph: communities, modularity, god nodes, surprising connections, and suggested questions.

full.description: Return the complete report instead of the bounded summary

rebuild.description: Rebuild the graph in memory before reporting (no file write)

top.description: Communities, god nodes, and surprises to keep (default 10)

name: list_archived_memories
description: List archived and superseded memories with state, reason, authority, actor, restore deadline and restorable flag, plus aggregate counts and hash-chain health. Sensitive archive titles and notes are redacted.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

name: list_crew
description: List all active crewmates with zero-token liveness status (running, idle, completed, failed). Uses OS process probes, not LLM API calls.

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: list_decisions
description: List addressed epistemic decisions (D<number>) with optional status or goal filter.

project.description: Target project ID (defaults to cwd project)

status.description: Filter by status: open, resolved, superseded, abandoned, or all (default all)

name: list_feedback
description: Retrieve recorded agent feedback, suggestions, issues, and tips across projects for periodic review.

category.description: Optional category filter: idea, issue, tip, challenge, praise

project.description: Optional project ID filter

status.description: Optional status filter: open, closed, in_progress, wontfix

name: list_goals
description: List goal packages in the project's goals/ directory, including titles, descriptions, implementation statuses, and /goal launch commands.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of goals to return

project.description: Optional project ID or workspace root directory

slug.description: Optional goal slug under goals/<slug>; required together with task_id to inspect a specific task packet

task_id.description: Optional stable task ID (e.g. T-001); required together with slug to return a TaskPacket

name: list_memories
description: List typed memory records with kind, recency and supersession filters, plus grounded/authority counts. Superseded records are excluded unless include_superseded is true.

include_superseded.description: Include records superseded by a relation

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

name: list_memory_feedback
description: List memory relevance feedback with signal counts, accepted versus superseded rows, bound versus unbound rows, and the most adjusted memories. Archived and superseded history is included; notes are local only.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

signal.description: Optional signal filter: helped, verified, less_important, irrelevant, wrong

name: list_projects
description: List indexed project repositories with message, claim, and verified fact counts, with optional substring query and limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (default 20, max 200)

query.description: Optional search query to filter by project path or ID

name: list_skills
description: List available agent skills in compact summary form (slug, name, 1-sentence prompt trigger, token estimate) for progressive context disclosure without inlining full runbooks.

filter.description: Optional filter string to match against skill slugs, names, or triggers

project.description: Optional project directory or ID (default: active workspace)

name: manage_merge_slot
description: Acquire, heartbeat, release, or inspect the project merge-slot lease; busy returns MERGE_SLOT_BUSY.

force.description: Force release without a matching token

lease_seconds.description: Lease length in seconds, clamped to 60 through 14400

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

token.description: Token from acquire, required for heartbeat and release

name: memory_archive
description: Archive a current memory with an explicit reason and authority. Archived memories leave recall, prime and default search but stay readable, auditable and restorable. Archive never deletes content; hard delete is refused.

duplicate_of.description: Required target memory id when reason is duplicate

note.description: Optional bounded note (max 500 characters); required for reason other

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

reason.description: Required reason: wrong, outdated, duplicate, sensitive, superseded, user_requested, other

name: memory_feedback
description: Report whether a memory returned by a specific recall pack helped, was verified, mattered less, was irrelevant, or was wrong. Requires the pack retrieval_id and the memory_id it returned; later signals from the same agent supersede the earlier one. Feedback only adjusts recall ranking inside the memory's authority tier and never edits, archives, or deletes the memory.

memory_id.description: Memory record id returned by the retrieval (mem_...)

note.description: Optional bounded note (max 500 characters); secrets and absolute paths are rejected

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

retrieval_id.description: Retrieval id reported by recall or prime_context (ret_...)

signal.description: Relevance signal: helped, verified, less_important, irrelevant, wrong

name: memory_history
description: Return the append-only, hash-linked lifecycle chain for one memory and optionally verify it. A tampered chain reports the first broken event with MEMORY_CHAIN_BROKEN.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

name: memory_restore
description: Restore an archived memory to current by memory id or archive event id. Restoring an already-current memory is an idempotent no-op. Sensitive archives are user-restorable only; agent-verified archives expire after 24 hours for agents; superseded records cannot be restored.

id.description: Memory id or archive event id

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name

name: omni_search
description: Call BEFORE running raw grep, find, or git log. Search every knowledge tier in one query: invariants, claims, transcripts, commits, docs, and handoffs, looking for prior research, decisions, or cross-session history.

include_archived.description: Include archived and superseded memories (default false)

project.description: Optional project selector to scope search

role.description: Only return transcript hits with this role (user, assistant, commit)

semantic.description: Optional: if true, reranks candidates using TypeSafe System One assistance while preserving evidentiary tiers

since.description: RFC3339 lower bound on result timestamps

tool.description: Only return hits attributed to this source tool

name: pop_handoff
description: Pop and atomically claim the newest eligible pending handoff for the current working directory and branch.

agent_name.description: Name or role of the claiming agent.

branch.description: Optional git branch to scope the handoff baton to.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug (default: active workspace)

name: prime_context
description: Retrieve a session briefing: latest handoff, key facts, directives, and disk grounding. Call this ONCE at the start of a session in a known project.

all_goals.description: Optional inclusion of all completed roadmap goals instead of aggregate count + bounded recent goals (default: false)

budget.description: Optional target context token budget for declarative compression and token pruning (e.g. 8000, 16000)

cache_pinned.description: Optional Gobstopper cache-aware prompt pinning; segregates static system rules/tools at the top and dynamic handoff variables at the bottom (default: false)

codebase_map_chars.description: Optional maximum character budget for codebase symbol digest (default: 2000)

context.description: Optional task context object ({task, paths[], branch, head, symbols[]}); when present, the briefing includes a bounded task-scoped recall pack placed before the codebase map.

disable_codebase_map.description: Optional flag to disable automatic codebase symbol digest generation (default: false)

graph.description: Append a bounded graph summary (default false)

include_archived.description: Include archived and superseded memories in the briefing (default false)

include_markdown.description: Optional inclusion of full rendered markdown text within the structured JSON result (default: false; text is returned in content[0].text)

max_facts.description: Maximum number of key facts to include (default 5)

max_tokens.description: Optional target context token budget for deterministic multi-pressure degradation (default: 20000)

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug

name: query_graph
description: Rank and expand code + memory graph nodes for a question; returns a bounded subgraph with provenance scores.

files.description: Optional repository files to include as slice seeds

question.description: Question, symbol, or free-text terms to rank graph nodes

name: recall
description: Find prior resolutions for a problem before searching the web or trying workarounds. Use it when a command fails, a package misbehaves, or an error appears. Returns lessons first, then grounded claims and memos, then transcript hits with grounding and an unroll command.

context.description: Optional task context object: {task, paths[], branch, head, symbols[]}. A JSON-encoded object string is also accepted. Unknown fields are rejected.

include_archived.description: Include archived and superseded memories (default false)

max_tokens.description: Estimated token budget for the recall pack (256-8192, default 1200)

project.description: Optional project selector; ranks its hits first, never filters them out

query.description: Symptom, error message, package name, or API in the words you would search

semantic.description: Optional: rerank within tiers using TypeSafe System One assistance

name: reconcile_drift
description: Audit filesystem drift by re-verifying whether referenced repository files exist on disk for stored claims.

dry_run.description: Optional simulation mode; if true, audits drift without writing updates to SQLite (default: false)

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug (empty to reconcile all projects)

semantic.description: Optional System One semantic verification; evaluates whether referenced code excerpts substantiate or contradict stored claims (default: false)

name: record_feedback
description: Submit agent observations, recommendations, issues faced, tips, friction/challenges, or praise to help continuously improve sila.

category.description: Feedback category: idea, issue, tip, challenge, praise (default: idea)

content.description: Feedback content, recommendation, challenge, or message

fact_id.description: Optional fact ID to adjust retention salience for (helpful, not_helpful, stale, wrong)

id.description: Optional explicit epistemic ticket ID or custom slug (e.g. dialectic-subshell-paths or fb_dialectic-subshell-paths)

project.description: Optional project ID or repository name

share.description: Optional flag to anonymously share sanitized feedback with Sila maintainer via Cloudflare D1 edge

candidate_b.description: Second candidate proposal statement or diff

context_query.description: Optional background topic or decision context

project.description: Optional project ID or directory

rationale.description: Trade-off justification or architectural rationale for this choice

name: release_goal
description: Release a claimed goal lock, returning the goal to the ready-to-execute pending pool.

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: reopen_goal
description: Safely reopen an implemented goal package for remediation, clearing prior completion state and returning it to pending or claimed.

claim.description: If true, immediately claim the goal for remediation

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: report_goal
description: Report intermediate progress or update status note for an in-progress goal.

client_kind.description: Client runtime kind (e.g. ai_agent, human, ci_job)

note.description: Progress report or status update note

origin_entity.description: Attribution identity or organization (e.g. org:waqftech, pat:personal, system)

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

status.description: Optional execution status (e.g. in_progress, evaluating, blocked)

task_checkpoint.description: Optional structured task checkpoint conforming to sila/task-checkpoint/v1

tool_name.description: Client or tool name (e.g. antigravity, cursor, claude-code)

prompt.description: Clear explanation of the action requiring human approval

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for approval before timing out (default: 300, max: 3600)

name: resolve_decision
description: Record an in-place resolution for an open addressed decision (D<number>).

choice.description: Chosen option letter (e.g. 'A') or resolution summary

name: resolve_feedback

harness.description: Harness runner: auto, claude, agy, mock (default: mock for instant in-process preflight, or auto)

origin_entity.description: Attribution identity or organization (e.g. org:waqftech, pat:personal, system)

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name (default: active workspace)

tool_name.description: Client or tool name (e.g. antigravity, cursor, claude-code)

name: save_memory
description: Persist a strict sila/memory/v1 envelope with typed assertions, evidence locators, relations and idempotency. Use when a decision needs machine-checkable structure beyond a prose memo. Unknown envelope fields are rejected with stable MEMORY_* codes.

client_kind.description: Client runtime kind (e.g. ai_agent, human, ci_job)

memory.description: sila/memory/v1 envelope object (a JSON-encoded object string is also accepted)

origin_entity.description: Attribution identity or organization (e.g. org:waqftech, pat:personal, system)

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name (default: active workspace)

tool_name.description: Client or tool name (e.g. antigravity, cursor, claude-code)

name: search_code
description: Search open-source code across public repositories on GitHub and optionally auto-ingest resulting code files into the project store.

auto_save.description: If true, fetches full raw source files and saves into project memory

project.description: Project ID to attach code docs to

query.description: Code search terms or syntax (e.g. 'sqlite fts5 tokenizer')

name: search_docs
description: Call BEFORE web search or scaffolding integrations to query indexed specifications and local documentation. Search attached external reference documents and API guides for a project using SQLite FTS5 full-text search.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug

name: search_knowledge
description: Search distilled knowledge, claims, and architectural decisions accumulated from past AI CLI sessions (Devin, OpenCode, Codex, AGY, ZCode, Claude Code, and more). PREFER THIS over reading files or git log when a question is about what was previously decided, built, or discovered — especially across different tools or before this repository existed. Returns attributed claims with file references.

facts_only.description: If true, only return promoted, LLM-distilled verified facts

include_archived.description: Include archived and superseded memories (default false)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

project.description: Optional project id or dir filter

refs_exist_only.description: If true, only return claims whose referenced repo files exist on disk

tool.description: Optional tool filter (devin, mimocode, opencode, codex, command-code, agy)

name: search_messages
description: Search the verbatim conversation transcripts of every indexed AI CLI tool on this machine. Use when you need the actual words exchanged in a past session — decisions in context, exact error messages, shell commands that were run — rather than distilled summaries of them.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

max_tokens.description: Optional maximum token budget per unrolled turn (default 800)

project.description: Optional project id or dir filter

since.description: Optional timestamp filter in RFC3339 format

tool.description: Optional tool filter (devin, mimocode, opencode, codex, etc.)

name: search_stackoverflow
description: Search developer QA, troubleshooting threads, and error resolutions on Stack Overflow and optionally auto-ingest solutions into project memory.

auto_save.description: If true, saves troubleshooting thread into project knowledge store

project.description: Project ID to attach solutions to

name: search_web_docs
description: Search live online documentation using Google Custom Search and optionally auto-ingest resulting documentation pages into the project store.

auto_save.description: If true, fetches and saves full Markdown content for top results

project.description: Project ID to attach documents to

name: shortest_path
description: Find the most reliable confidence-weighted path between two graph nodes; ambiguous bare names fail with candidates.

code_only.description: Follow only code relations and skip memory nodes

source.description: Source node ID, qualified symbol, or unique label

target.description: Target node ID, qualified symbol, or unique label

name: skill_load
description: Retrieve complete instructions, metadata, and optional resources (scripts, references) for a specific skill from project or global catalogs without persistent state mutation.

include_resources.description: If true, include contents of referenced scripts and documentation files (default false)

include_scripts.description: If true, include contents of referenced scripts and documentation files (alias for include_resources)

project.description: Optional project directory or ID (default: active workspace)

slug.description: Exact skill slug or identifier to load

name: skill_search
description: Search available agent skills across project and global libraries by keyword, technology, or task description. Returns bounded skill summaries with source provenance without loading full instruction bodies.

limit.description: Maximum number of skill summaries to return (default 10, max 50)

project.description: Optional project directory or ID (default: active workspace)

query.description: Search terms, topic, skill name, technology, or task intent

tags.description: Optional tags or category filters to narrow search results

name: spawn_crewmate
description: Spawn a crewmate agent in a disposable Git worktree with a tmux session window. The crewmate is bound to a goal package and auto-seeded with sila context. Zero-token supervision via OS process probes.

base_ref.description: Optional git ref to branch from (default: HEAD)

goal_slug.description: Goal package slug the crewmate will work on

harness.description: AI CLI tool to spawn: devin, claude, agy, opencode, codex, mimocode

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: supersede_goal
description: Mark a goal superseded by another goal, release, or commit, releasing its claim and charter.

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

superseded_by.description: Superseding goal slug, release, or commit

name: supervise_crew
description: Run zero-token supervision pass over all crewmates, probing liveness via OS process checks and pane activity. When sentinel is enabled, executes dual-cron supervision with isolated Victory Auditor and bounded retries.

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

sentinel.description: Enable Sentinel dual-cron supervision with isolated Victory Auditor and bounded retries

name: sync_rules
description: Compile Core Hub agent standards, Universal Principles Pack, and project overlays, projecting updated rule files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/000-sila-core.mdc, .cursor/rules/000-sila-principles.mdc, .windsurfrules, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .devin/setup.sh) across all detected tool targets.

include_principles.description: Include Universal Principles Pack (Layered Constitution & 9-verb memory loop)

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

stack.description: Optional target stack for tailored principles (go, ts, cloudflare, python, rust, polyglot)

tools.description: Optional list of tools to compile rules for (claude, cursor, devin, windsurf, copilot, agents, all)

name: touch_goal
description: Renew the claim lease and heartbeat timestamp for an active goal without requiring long-running process persistence.

agent.description: Optional agent name renewing the lease

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

name: update_goal
description: Update an existing goal's metadata, dependencies, files to touch, shape, tier, personas, or spec review with preflight validation.

add_deps.description: Add these goal slugs as dependencies

depends_on.description: Replace dependency list with these goal slugs

independent.description: Explicitly mark the goal independent or dependent

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

remove_deps.description: Remove these goal slugs from dependencies

spec_review.description: Structured spec_review object conforming to sila/spec-review/v1

strict.description: Fail on preflight warnings or file collisions

tier.description: Goal tier: immediate, roadmap, nice-to-have, wont-fix

name: vacuum_database
description: Run SQLite VACUUM and optimize query planner statistics on the knowledge store, defragmenting storage and reclaiming disk space.

force.description: If true, forces a full vacuum even if freelist fragmentation is low

name: validate_goals
description: Run deterministic goal package, dependency, lifecycle, and registry validation.

project.description: Optional project ID or repository directory

slug.description: Optional single goal slug to validate

name: validate_memory
description: Validate an envelope without writing; never mutates the store

memory.description: sila/memory/v1 envelope object (a JSON-encoded object string is also accepted)

project.description: Optional project ID or directory name used for evidence checks
